segments.name: EMEA
segments.description: Wholesale and retail activities under the Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein brands across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
segments.evidence: Our EMEA segment includes the results of our Tommy Hilfiger wholesale and retail activities in EMEA.

segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Wholesale and retail activities under the Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein brands in the Americas, including joint ventures in Mexico, North America legwear and Brazil.
segments.evidence: Our Americas segment includes the results of our Tommy Hilfiger wholesale and retail activities in the Americas, and our proportionate share of the net income or loss of our investments in our joint venture in Mexico and legwear joint venture in North America ("PVH Legwear") relating to each joint venture's Tommy Hilfiger business, and in our joint venture for the Tommy Hilfiger brand in Brazil.

segments.name: Licensing
segments.description: Licensing of the Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein trademarks to third parties for a broad range of product categories and territories.
segments.evidence: Additionally, we generate revenue from fees for licensing the use of our TOMMY HILFIGER and Calvin Klein trademarks.
